mathematical_sources.note: This paper [PRW] is the source of the original bounded-orbit results. The present extension proves the derived-singular-set assertion announced there without proof, removes unnecessary local hypotheses, extends the local results to arbitrary Riemann surfaces, adds the positive-area result and classical no-wandering corollaries. Surface derived-set accumulation now applies without a simple-connectivity hypothesis, by an adaptation of the Baker–Kotus–Lü argument. The exact independent statements are in Challenge.lean, with proofs exposed by Solution.lean. The authors of [PRW] and [DPU] are preparing a joint preprint containing these results. No independent human review or acceptance of this updated package is claimed.

mathematical_sources.title: Iterates of Meromorphic Functions IV: Critically Finite Functions
mathematical_sources.note: The covering and filling argument is adapted to fixed-radius covering discs of locally defined maps. Removable-point completion and discrete backward orbits remove the simple-connectivity hypothesis from the local derived-singular theorem. The formalisation does not assert that whole later local components become simply connected. A separate finite-type theorem and its meromorphic class S corollary are deduced from the resulting derived-singular statement.

mathematical_sources.title: Towers of finite type complex analytic maps
mathematical_sources.note: CUNY PhD thesis (1993). The finite-type no-wandering conclusion is recovered here as a corollary of the derived-singular theorem, not by formalising Epstein's original deformation argument. The target surface is compact; the source is an arbitrary open subset. Our statement permits removable source punctures, so no maximality assumption is needed.
